info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Human Resource Management By Param1-spec
info.description: The Human Resource Management Update API enables the modification of workforce training details within the human resource management system. This endpoint allows users to update specific training parameters, enhancing workforce skills and compliance. Typically utilized by HR managers and training administrators, it supports scenarios such as adjusting training records or adding new qualifications based on evolving business needs. The API fosters effective workforce development and alignment with organizational goals.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of a specific workforce training resource identified by its unique ID (RES-100045). Use this operation to modify attributes such as training content, schedule, or associated personnel.

requestBody.description: Update the details related to workforce training with the specified resource identifier. This request body expects a JSON object that contains the fields necessary for partial updates of the training details.

200.description: The request was successful, and the resource has been updated.
